subject: A flicker-perception threshold may mark the edge of adult brain plasticity
script: From Agewell Brief: A flicker-perception threshold may mark the edge of adult brain plasticity. A new review explores critical flicker fusion frequency—the point where flickering light looks steady—as a stable trait that may mark the edge of adult brain plasticity. CFFF is highly stable within individuals, unlike spatial skills. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
